action: Traced the paired dark deck features and existing role, motion, collision and socket contracts back to Kit's Forge recipe and runtime driver.
observation: The rectangles are intentionally empty patient mounts with paired cradle rims, rather than missing textures. The owner and reviewer found them difficult to read as rescue berths from the current top-down views; the broad deck also lacks a clear sense of construction depth. The lamp is a named acknowledge pivot; four common sockets and the deck/cabin collision components are source contracts.
decision: Request a Kit-only Astra candidate that makes the existing empty berths and deck construction legible while preserving the skiff silhouette, crew identity, animated lamp, sockets and collision. Do not add patients or infer an LOD-normal defect from a single sequential capture.

action: Compared the same Kit LOD0, LOD2, LOD0 sequence under one renderer session and inspected the surface normals of the three packaged deck meshes.
observation: The complete nine-draw side frames show LOD0 returning to its original appearance after the glossier LOD2, so first-shot lighting does not explain the side-view difference. The first top shot had only seven draws and was excluded. On near-horizontal deck triangles, area-weighted face-to-vertex mean dot is 1.000 at LOD0, 0.932 at LOD1 and 0.765 at LOD2, showing progressively smoothed vertex normals across flat deck faces; this is a strong contributor candidate, not proof of the sole lighting cause.
decision: Include Kit-only hard planar deck normals across LODs in the Astra candidate, alongside improved empty-berth construction; do not alter global lighting or shared Forge defaults.
next: Compare an exported candidate at matched angles and through the ordinary Ceres route, including sockets, motion and collision.
evidenceScope: Same-session isolated renderer side views and static package normal inspection; first top frame excluded; not ordinary gameplay.
performance: Nine target draws in valid compared side shots; no live performance measurement or model change.
